from browser_use.llm.ollama.serializer import OllamaMessageSerializer

class DummyImagePart:
    def __init__(self, url: str, type_name: str = 'image_url'):
        self.type = type_name
        class Img:
            def __init__(self, u):
                self.url = u
        self.image_url = Img(url)

def test_ollama_serializer_extracts_image_type_and_url():
    # Data URL with tiny base64 payload ("hello")
    data_url = 'data:image/png;base64,aGVsbG8='

    # Part with type 'image' (new supported type)

    assert hasattr(first_image, 'value')
    # The base64 decoded value of 'aGVsbG8=' is b'hello'
    assert first_image.value == b'hello'
